dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge featuring a prominent V-shaped notch located approximately midway between the dorsal ridge and the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the fin's highest vertical coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an approximate 55-degree incline relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.25:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is present on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse light-colored horizontal band across the lower-third of the fin; several small, high-luminance white punctate marks distributed across the posterior basal region.
